record.question: What does Article 310 of the Constitution of India state about the tenure of persons serving the Union or a State?
options: They hold office permanently unless removed by the President or Governor
They hold office during the pleasure of the President or the Governor
They can only be removed by a resolution passed by the Parliament or StateLegislature
They hold office during the pleasure of the Supreme Court of India
record.explanation: Article 310 states office is held during the pleasure of the President or Governor.
